summary: Engine only, no cards wired: P24 small effect primitives (SwitchLocations, AttackSpec for home/any-location targets and printed-Force comparison, each-player hand shuffle, Ring-bow cost substitution and the CostWaivers channel, slot categories for remove/destroy costs, three-stat tokens, a source-straightens control return); P4 turn boundary (EngineHooks.TurnBegins with a pausable choice, owner-relative durations for the delay store, timed removal and Event expiry, player-level granted abilities, turn-scoped rules EndTurnExtraDraw and LimitedAsOpen); P22 created cards, copies and grants (CreatedCardSpec.RemoveWhen, current-value and Focus-Value stats, declared abilities and traits, ExchangeStats/CopyStat/SetStat, OverlayOnto, control-changing attachment transfer, filter grants and granted traits; The Wind's Champion and Never Without a Weapon migrated with tests unchanged). Shared edits are mostly one-line calls; exceptions: three lines in CardAbilities for LimitedAsOpen, a QueryActions arm for the turn-begins choice, and whitespace the format check forced in EmperorMechB.cs and EmperorRulingR5.cs. Each card into a hand now bumps a per-turn counter.
